Results.ReviewText: Overall this is a nice basic grill for a couple or small family which is what we wanted. Weber grills have been a mainstay for me so I knew what I was getting. One small "complaint" - I wish they would put higher quality wheels on all of their grills. Grills are outdoor tools and face some rather harsh weather elements. I've always covered my grills but over time the plastic wheels are susceptible to weakening due to exposure to the sun and changing temperatures. I live in the upper Midwest so we have great variance in temperature over the year. This too plays havoc with the plastic wheels - steel or even dense rubber wheels would be a great improvement and even help when moving a grill across various surfaces - concrete, gravel, etc.

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill several months ago to replace a previous version of the Spirit grill that was 11 years old and totally rusted out. I loved the older grill, but I do not like this one. We primarily cook using indirect heat, and using the old version of the grill, we were able to achieve crispy doneness on the outside grilled meats. Despite trying various temperatures, adjustments, and techniques, we are unable to get especially chicken skin done satisfactorily, and it turns out rubbery and flaccid, ugh. I also do not like that the burners run front to back, instead of side to side, which leaves one much less usable space on the grate, and forces one to sometimes push the meat up under the hanging warming rack connected to the grill lid. It is hard to do this without burning ones hand. I have been very satisfied with previous Weber grills we have owned, both charcoal and gas, but I am disappointed in this grill. I would only recommend it for people who use primarily direct heat cooking.

Results.ReviewText: I finally decided to stop buying cheap grills, and bought a Weber.  This grill is by far the best that I've ever owned.  Although it only has two burners, it gets very hot very quickly, and can search a steak without a problem.  Also, the heat is even throughout the grill, which eliminates the need to constantly shuffle food around the grill.  In the past, I had bought cheap grills, and had to replace them every two years or so.  The Weber is extremely well constructed, and with the 10 year warranty, you can't go wrong.

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together.
